title: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) Verification Gateway
subtitle: Cryptographically prove predicates (age, residency, citizenship) without revealing sensitive underlying personal data.
zkpExplanationTitle: How Zero-Knowledge Proofs Protect Citizen Privacy
zkpExplanationBody: Zero-Knowledge Proofs allow you to mathematically prove that a statement is true (such as 'I am over 18 years old' or 'I am registered in Taipei City') without disclosing your birthdate, exact address, or national ID number. Relying parties receive verifiable mathematical certainty with zero privacy leakage.
